mode: Audit and plan first. Do not edit, commit, push or deploy until the user approves the implementation plan.

role.identity: Act as a senior strategy, design and engineering team operating at COLLINS-level strategic discipline.
role.instruction: Do not imitate COLLINS layouts, copy, animations or identity. Apply the principles of one memorable idea, strong art direction, decisive typography, restraint, proof and commercial clarity.

mission.primary: Rebuild tangison.com as the flagship multi-page website for Tangison Technologies.
mission.desired_impression: A credible Namibian technology company building applied intelligence systems for real operational environments.

repository.strategy: Use the Agent repository as a technical donor or GitHub template only if it passes the audit. Never overwrite or repurpose the existing Agent product repository.
repository.recommended_destination: Create a separate repository for the Tangison Technologies website.

reuse_template_when: the project builds successfully from a clean install
TypeScript is strict or can be made strict without major breakage
there are reusable header, motion, image, metadata and accessibility primitives
product-specific Agent code can be removed cleanly
the template does not lock the new website into a single-page architecture
start_fresh_when: the clean build fails because of structural debt
the codebase contains tightly coupled product logic
the route structure is unsuitable for a marketing website
the accessibility foundation is materially broken
the dependency graph is bloated or obsolete
removing Agent-specific code would take longer than recreating the shared shell
decision_rule.preferred_outcome: A hybrid rebuild: start from a separate copy of the Agent technical foundation, remove all Agent-specific product content, and rebuild the information architecture, components, copy and visual experience from zero.

required_checks: Confirm repository visibility, default branch and clean working tree.
Read README, package manifest, lockfile, framework configuration, TypeScript configuration and deployment configuration.
Inventory routes, layouts, components, styles, fonts, images, motion utilities and metadata helpers.
Identify product-specific Agent code that must not be inherited.
Run lint, typecheck, tests and production build.
Inspect the desktop and mobile interface.
Check keyboard navigation, focus states, contrast, reduced motion and overlay accessibility.
Measure dependency weight and identify packages that can be removed.
Report what should be reused, rewritten, removed or replaced.
phase_0_repository_audit.stop_condition: Present the audit and plan to the user. Wait for explicit approval before implementation.

rules: Never regenerate, redraw or approximate the Tangison logo.
Do not bake the logo into generated website imagery.
Preserve clear space and aspect ratio.
Use the SVG for header, footer, favicon source and social composition.

positioning.primary_support: Tangison Technologies designs operational intelligence systems for environments where connectivity, data and infrastructure cannot be assumed.

message_framework.observe: Connect fragmented signals without pretending the underlying environment is perfect.
message_framework.decide: Turn incomplete operational information into useful, accountable decisions.
message_framework.operate: Automate repeatable action while preserving human control and clear boundaries.

copy_rules: Express one ideology rather than advertising a long catalogue of services.
Sound technically sophisticated but remain understandable.
Use concrete nouns and active verbs.
Do not repeat the headline in the supporting copy.
Do not use fabricated metrics, clients, testimonials or deployment claims.
Avoid revolutionise, cutting-edge, game-changing, seamless, unlock and next-generation.
Avoid vague phrases such as solutions for tomorrow.

information_architecture.architecture: True multi-page website with route-level pages. Do not build a single-page website.

pages.name: Home
pages.purpose: State the ideology, show the system visually and create one clear conversion path.

pages.name: Technology
pages.purpose: Explain Tangison as one operational intelligence system rather than many disconnected services.

pages.name: Company
pages.purpose: Explain Tangison Technologies, its Namibian origin, working principles and ecosystem.
sections: Tangison Studio, Agent and Labs ecosystem
pages.team_policy: Do not create a visible team gallery for now. Include the known members only in Organization structured data.

pages.name: Contact
pages.purpose: Provide a short, low-friction enquiry route.
sections: Name, email, organisation and message form

information_architecture.future_route_rule: Do not publish Work or Field Notes until there is real, honest content.

visual_system.asset_rule: Every raster image must contain no more than two dominant visual elements.
composition: Use large editorial images rather than repeated small cards.
Use negative space as an active design element.
Allow alternating light and dark sections.
Do not cover every image with a heavy black overlay.
Do not place more than two major content blocks in one viewport.
Keep interfaces calm enough that each image can carry the narrative.

typography.display: Cabinet Grotesk or the existing verified Tangison display face
typography.body: Satoshi or the existing verified Tangison body face
typography.technical: JetBrains Mono used only for limited metadata
rules: Body text must remain comfortably readable.
Do not apply extreme letter spacing to ordinary navigation or buttons.
Keep technical monospace text below 10 percent of visible copy.

buttons.style: Text links or compact rounded pills

horizontal_rail.purpose: Create an image-led narrative break without turning the site into a card grid.
interaction: Use native horizontal scrolling with CSS scroll snap.
Support mouse, touch, trackpad and keyboard.
Keep headings and captions as live HTML outside the images.

desktop: Authentic Tangison logo on the left
Technology, Company and Contact on the right
mobile: Simple full-height list only when opened
accessibility: When closed, mobile navigation must use inert or be unmounted.
When open, apply focus management, Escape close and focus return.
Do not leave invisible links in the accessibility tree.

rules: Use one hairline divider and generous but controlled spacing.

team_metadata.rule: Do not invent surnames, titles, biographies, portraits or credentials.

architecture: Use route-level server-rendered or statically generated pages.
Do not build the website as a single-page application.
Prefer server components and progressive enhancement.
Do not initialise essential content at opacity zero.
The core website must remain readable if animation JavaScript fails.
images: Use responsive sizes and explicit width-height or aspect-ratio.
Never upscale a source beyond its useful resolution.
motion: Motion communicates hierarchy and continuity only.
Use subtle transforms and opacity transitions.
forms: Every control requires a visible label and name attribute.
Use real POST handling with server-side validation.
Provide loading, success and error states.
Prevent spam without displaying a visible honeypot.
Do not expose secrets in the client.
seo: Unique title and description per page.
Open Graph and Twitter metadata using the supplied OG image.
Organization, WebSite and relevant Service structured data.
Include the known team members only in Organization.member metadata.
Generate robots.txt and sitemap.xml from the production domain.
Redirect retired Tangison routes rather than leaving stale indexed pages.
Noindex internal brand-system or staging routes.
accessibility: Sufficient contrast for all text and controls.
Semantic landmarks and one logical H1 per page.
Accessible horizontal rail instructions and controls.

content_boundaries: Do not publish fake case studies.
Do not imply products are active if they are still in development.
Do not invent clients, certifications, partnerships, deployment numbers or impact metrics.
Do not create a visible team section until approved.
Do not add a blog, pricing page, careers page or dashboard without a real requirement.
Do not turn Observe, Decide and Operate into three separate companies or unrelated service cards.

required_visual_checks: footer at short and long viewport heights

after_plan_approval: Import the lean WebP asset package.
Remove unused dependencies and inherited Agent content.
Provide a page inventory, changed-file summary, test evidence and remaining content gaps.
Do not deploy or modify DNS unless the user explicitly asks.
